Investigation timeline: the investigation should complete within 45 days of filing_date (90 for international/POS). Measure to resolution_date where the dispute is resolved, otherwise to the current time (get_time). If a dispute is past either timeline, tell the customer and offer to escalate it to a supervisor. steps.quote: This parameter records metadata only; the agent must separately perform the indicated card action after filing the dispute.

steps.do: Freeze the card.
steps.if: the most severe card_action is freeze_pending_investigation and the card is ACTIVE
steps.quote: Use freeze_debit_card_3892 with the card_id

rules.rule: Use fraud categories, never unauthorized_transaction, when fraud is suspected.
rules.quote: 'card_present_fraud': Physical card used fraudulently (not by customer) - USE THIS when fraud suspected and card was physically present

draft.done_when: Each unrecognized transaction is filed or the customer has been told the unmet requirement. The customer has been told their liability exposure. The card action has been carried out.
